stem:
The Venn diagram shows the relationship among several sets of numbers.

Where should \(- \sqrt{169} \) be placed in the Venn diagram?

options.label: A
options.text: Rational numbers, because \(- \sqrt{169} \) is equal to \(- 84.5\)

options.label: C
options.text: Irrational numbers, because \(- \sqrt{169} \) is equal to \(- 84.5\)

options.label: D
options.text: Whole numbers, because \(- \sqrt{169} \) is equal to 13

visual_elements: Venn diagram with Real numbers containing Rational numbers and Irrational numbers; Rational numbers containing Integers; Integers containing Whole numbers; Whole numbers containing Natural numbers
